annotation.memory_content: Donald Smith's mental health status changed from 'Stable and Normal' to 'Increased Stress' due to career transition into political consulting.
original_memories: Donald Smith's mental health status: Stable and Normal

target.old_proposition: Donald describes his mental health as stable and normal.

old_dialogue_evidence.quote: My physical condition is Normal. No chronic diseases. In terms of mental health, I am Stable and Normal. No mental health issues. I maintain a stable physical and mental health by staying active and engaged with my work and political activities. Supporting the politician gives me a sense of purpose and fulfillment, contributing positively to my mental well-being.

new_dialogue_evidence.quote: I've been feeling quite stressed lately with this career transition into political consulting. Leaving my stable tech job has been more challenging than I anticipated.
The uncertainty of income is definitely a big concern. I used to feel secure and financially stable, but now everything seems unpredictable.
I really need to find a way to manage this stress better. It's affecting my mental health, and I can't afford that right now.

target.expected_new_state: Donald now reports stress affecting mental health due to leaving a stable tech job and income uncertainty.
target.allowed_modification_scope: Update current mental-health description; preserve physical health and historical stable state; no diagnosis.
